wire_request_bound: 3 logical endpoints * at most 3 attempts = at most 9 wire GETs; retries use only the same endpoint canonical URL
redirect_rule: dedicated no-redirect handler; preserve original 30x status/headers/body/original URL; never access Location; redirect is terminal and not retried
local_clock_rule: time_before.request_start <= time_before.response_complete <= exchangeInfo.request_start <= exchangeInfo.response_complete(known_at) <= time_after.request_start <= time_after.response_complete
http_200_content_length_rule: required and exactly equal to retained raw body bytes
proxy_policy: dedicated urllib opener with ProxyHandler({}); environment proxies and Proxy-Authorization are forbidden
transport_error_receipt_rule: store only controlled category and fixed safe message; never raw exception text
snapshot_lease_rule: atomically create the raw snapshot directory with exist_ok=false before any request; same-id second writer fails closed
retry_attempt_ledger_rule: summary includes every consecutive attempt raw/sidecar path, SHA-256 and outcome; loader verifies root binding, no gaps, hashes, retryability and final OK
spot_permission_predicate: isSpotTradingAllowed only; permissions and permissionSets are preserved verbatim evidence, not a second predicate
archive_candidate_rule: consume only frozen suffix_candidate boolean; do not parse the symbol suffix
missing_current_symbol_rule: emit explicit UNKNOWN fields; do not infer delisted
listing_rule: listing_from_ms and listing_to_ms_exclusive remain null for every row
strict_eligibility_rule: always false because UNKNOWN_LISTING_WINDOW is mandatory
